ui.hub.comments.delete.confirm.role: Native browser confirmation question before comment deletion
ui.hub.comments.delete.confirm.note: The existing window.confirm flow and cancellation behavior remain unchanged; deletion happens only after confirmation.

ui.hub.comments.heading.note: Names comments on a public agent listing, not generated agent output.

ui.hub.comments.form.label.note: Only rendered for signed-in users; existing comments remain readable without this form.

ui.hub.comments.form.placeholder.note: Entered comment text is author data and must not be translated.

ui.hub.comments.form.posting.length_hint: Screen-reader spinner label, no visible width budget
ui.hub.comments.form.posting.note: Submit request is pending; not a success receipt.

ui.hub.comments.form.submit.note: Disabled for an empty trimmed draft and while posting.

ui.hub.comments.form.sign_in.tone: Explain prerequisite without claiming list failure
ui.hub.comments.form.sign_in.length_hint: One short sentence above readable comment list
ui.hub.comments.form.sign_in.note: Readers must sign in to write comments; this does not mean reading requires sign-in.

ui.hub.comments.empty.note: There are no existing comments; distinguishes an empty successful load from a load failure.

ui.hub.comments.edit.label.role: Edit-comment textarea accessible label and edit-button tooltip/name
ui.hub.comments.edit.label.length_hint: Screen-reader label and short icon tooltip
ui.hub.comments.edit.label.note: Used on author-only edit controls and the edit field; does not itself save a change.

ui.hub.comments.edit.cancel.note: Discards the local edit draft and leaves the posted comment unchanged.

ui.hub.comments.edit.saving.role: Accessible spinner label while saving edited comment
ui.hub.comments.edit.saving.note: An update request is pending, not a new comment publication.

ui.hub.comments.edit.save.note: Saves the edited author text, then leaves edit mode after successful response.

ui.hub.comments.author.unknown.note: Fallback when account metadata lacks a display name; real author names remain unchanged.

ui.hub.comments.delete.label.role: Delete-comment icon tooltip and accessible name
ui.hub.comments.delete.label.length_hint: Short tooltip and screen-reader button label
ui.hub.comments.delete.label.note: Opens the existing native confirmation before deleting an author-owned comment.

ui.hub.comments.load_error.tone: Clear load failure followed by its reason
ui.hub.comments.load_error.note: The reason comes from the failed query. Preserve arbitrary server text rather than inventing a localized cause.

placeholders.reason: Error.message from the query/mutation, including the locally translated authentication refusal when applicable. Preserve arbitrary backend text unchanged.

ui.hub.comments.mutation.unauthorized.role: Local authentication refusal thrown by comment mutations
ui.hub.comments.mutation.unauthorized.length_hint: One short error sentence, also nested in failure toast
ui.hub.comments.mutation.unauthorized.note: Only the locally generated refusal is translated; no wire code or server message matching changes.

ui.hub.comments.mutation.posted.note: Shown after create succeeds and comments-list invalidation runs.

ui.hub.comments.mutation.updated.note: Shown after update succeeds and the specific agent comments list is invalidated.

ui.hub.comments.mutation.deleted.note: Shown only after delete succeeds; not when the confirmation was canceled.

ui.hub.comments.mutation.post_failed.role: Error toast after failed comment creation
ui.hub.comments.mutation.post_failed.tone: Clear action failure followed by cause
ui.hub.comments.mutation.post_failed.length_hint: Short toast prefix plus wrapped dynamic reason
ui.hub.comments.mutation.post_failed.note: Creation failed; the draft is not claimed posted.

placeholders.reason: Error.message from the query/mutation, including the locally translated authentication refusal when applicable. Preserve arbitrary backend text unchanged.

ui.hub.comments.mutation.update_failed.role: Error toast after failed comment update
ui.hub.comments.mutation.update_failed.tone: Clear save failure followed by cause
ui.hub.comments.mutation.update_failed.length_hint: Short toast prefix plus wrapped dynamic reason
ui.hub.comments.mutation.update_failed.note: The edit request failed; does not imply a new comment was created.

placeholders.reason: Error.message from the query/mutation, including the locally translated authentication refusal when applicable. Preserve arbitrary backend text unchanged.

ui.hub.comments.mutation.delete_failed.role: Error toast after failed comment deletion
ui.hub.comments.mutation.delete_failed.tone: Clear delete failure followed by cause
ui.hub.comments.mutation.delete_failed.length_hint: Short toast prefix plus wrapped dynamic reason
ui.hub.comments.mutation.delete_failed.note: Deletion failed; does not claim the comment was removed.

placeholders.reason: Error.message from the query/mutation, including the locally translated authentication refusal when applicable. Preserve arbitrary backend text unchanged.

ui.hub.comments.age.seconds.length_hint: One metadata line beneath author name
ui.hub.comments.age.seconds.note: Date-fns strict rounding chooses the integer second count. Message owns both unit inflection and ago. Preserve old always-ago behavior even if the comment timestamp is in the future.
ui.hub.comments.age.seconds.plural_guidance: Use the target locale’s CLDR categories: ru/pl few/many and ar zero/two/few/many as needed. Each branch owns the complete relative-age phrase, so word order need not mirror English.

placeholders.count: Nonnegative integer from date-fns strict unit rounding; print ungrouped using plain {count} rather than # or {count, number} to retain original English digits.

ui.hub.comments.age.fallback.role: Fallback comment age if date-fns adds an unknown strict token
ui.hub.comments.age.fallback.length_hint: One metadata line beneath author name
ui.hub.comments.age.fallback.note: Currently unreachable for the six strict distance tokens. Keeps previous English duration as safe fallback for a future library token.

placeholders.duration: English duration from date-fns enUS formatter for an unknown future token; no suffix yet.
